decisionMemo.businessProblem: A subscription business stemmed a churn spike; the owner wants the recovery sequence that worked rather than the one that failed.

rootCauseDiagnosis.mechanismDescription: Without follow-up, loyalty program, or service innovation, customers default to shopping for best price on each transaction.
alternativeExplanations: Service may not meet customer needs

intervention.title: Design and launch customer loyalty program
intervention.objective: Create incentive for repeat business and data capture for customer relationship management
intervention.rationale: Systematic retention mechanism replaces transactional, one-time customer model
intervention.whyThisNow: Revenue is declining due to low repeat rate; immediate action to rebuild recurring revenue

steps.title: Design loyalty program structure
steps.description: Points-based or tiered program; benchmark against industry, competitor research
steps.successCriteria: Program design reviewed, discount budget allocated

steps.title: Implement simple tracking system
steps.description: Use email or phone-based customer identification to track repeat visits
steps.successCriteria: System tested, staff trained, can enroll customer in <30 seconds

steps.title: Launch to current customer base
steps.description: Send email or in-person invitation to 50+ previous customers; track enrollment rate
steps.successCriteria: Email sent to prior customers, enrollment rate >20%, feedback gathered

successMetrics: Loyalty program enrollment >50% of customer base
failureRisks: Customers engage for discount only, churn when offer expires
intervention.fallbackPlan: Pivot to referral program (existing customers get discount for bringing new customers)

factors.rationale: Expected revenue impact: SIGNIFICANT. Urgency: HIGH
Duration: 7 days. Team capacity: MEDIUM. Cost: LOW
Failure risks: 3. Fallback plan available: Yes
Cost band: LOW vs Expected impact: SIGNIFICANT

recommendedInterventions.sequencingReason: Quick implementation builds momentum and shows progress

scenarios.name: Aggressive Recovery (Best Case)
scenarios.description: Execute all interventions in optimal sequence with full team commitment
assumptions: Team capacity fully available (no other initiatives)
Client budget approved for all recommended interventions
No external market shocks during implementation
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Revenue recovery within 90 days, competitive positioning restored
risks: Cascading failures if one intervention stumbles

scenarios.name: Staged Implementation (Recommended)
scenarios.description: Execute top 3 prioritized interventions sequentially, measure, then decide on next wave
assumptions: Top 3 interventions address critical path to revenue recovery
Team capacity for 1-2 major initiatives at a time
Monthly review gates to assess progress and adjust
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Measurable improvement in 60 days, foundation for growth set
risks: Slower overall recovery than aggressive path
Competitors may advance while we execute gradually

nextReviewTriggers: After first intervention completion: validate assumptions, collect outcome data
